GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 463.5 (14 Dec 45) GD
(SCAPIN - 445)
14 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Provision of Coal at Fusan, Korea, for use of Commanding General, United States Army Forces in Korea.
1. Reference is made to letter this Headquarters dated 23 September 1945, subject as above, directing the shipment of 70,000 to 75,000 tons of coal monthly from Japan to Fusan, Korea.
2. You are directed to furnish this Headquarters with a summary showing the gross quantities of coal, by size and grade, shipped up to 30 November 1945. It is further directed that such a summary report be furnished by the sixth of every month hereafter for coal shipped in the proceeding month.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
